note: Wooded campground north of Highway 210, above the St. Louis River gorge and the swinging bridge. The park says most sites have trees and tight corners and suit smaller units; check the posted length of the site. --Claude
summary: DNR + ReserveMN: 79 drive-in sites (21 electric, mostly 30 amp, three 50), pads up to 58-60 ft (76 of 77 at 23 ft+; one pull-through, site 46), year-round with 12 winter sites, shower building closed until May 2027. Fees as stored. PIN MOVE ~360 m (stored point is the River Inn lot south of the highway). Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN MOVE (~360 m): stored 46.65450,-92.37100 is on the River Inn / visitor-area loop south of Highway 210 near the gorge; the campground loops are north of the highway. Drive-in unit centroid from ReserveMN MapInfo: 46.65763,-92.37227 (confirmed as wooded campsite loops on Esri imagery). Move there.
Phone: none stored. DNR contact '218-673-7000' (office, ext. 0). apply.py does not write phones: add 218-673-7000.

Rig fit: DNR seasonal update: 'Most sites will not accommodate very large rigs. This campground has lots of trees and tight corners, and is most suitable for smaller units.' The same agency publishes lengths up to 60 ft and ReserveMN lists 76 drive-in pads of 23 ft or more, so under the stated-length rule a 23-ft rig is not 'very large' here: keep, with the caveat now in the note.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. ReserveMN gives drive-in sites .2-.4 mile to water (the four walk-in sites .1 mile or less); the campground sits north of the highway, away from the St. Louis River gorge. No upgrade.
Status: no closure; the shower building is closed until May 2027 (in facilities.note), which is seasonal, not a campground closure.

Note cleaned: dropped 'River Inn drive-in state-park campground' (the River Inn is the visitor center, not the campground's name), and the hookups/showers/flush/dump/'Reservable online' text that the fields hold. Website OK (redirects to the new DNR park page).
